title: maja-box
description: Magazyn sceniczny obok głównej sceny, całkowicie niewidoczny z sali podczas ceremonii i z miejsc publiczności. W pustym zapleczu stoi ogromna kartonowa skrzynia na kompost, około 2,5 m szerokości, 1,4 m głębokości i 1,5 m wysokości. Musi pomieścić jednocześnie Maię oraz pełny stół DJ-ski z dwoma gramofonami i mikserem. Maia ukrywa się w środku; ponad uchylonymi klapami widać tylko jej głowę, platynowo-lawendowy bob, czarne słuchawki i odrobinę białej koszuli.

prompts.image: Cinematic 16:9 shot inside the separate stage-storage room shown beside the stage on the authoritative Dom Kultury floor plan. No view of the public hall, ceremony, stage, chairs, audience, projection screen or jury table. A huge 2.5-metre-wide battered cardboard compost crate must visibly be large enough to contain Maia Melodies together with a complete full-width DJ table, two turntables and mixer. Maia hides inside and cautiously peeks over the flaps. Preserve her exact identity, lavender-platinum bob, black headphones and white shirt. Match the building's aged plaster, dark green lower walls, worn wooden floor and warm tungsten lighting.
prompts.animation: Static locked camera. A short 2–3 second comedic beat. Maia Melodies remains hidden inside the huge cardboard compost crate with only her head and upper shoulders visible above the open flaps. She slowly rises just a few centimetres, cautiously glances to one side and then the other with her eyes and a very small head movement, then gently presses one earcup of her black headphones as if checking whether it is time to begin. Her expression is focused, mischievous and controlled; she does not speak or lip-sync. The cardboard flaps react only with tiny natural flexing from her movement. Preserve Maia's exact face, lavender-platinum bob, headphones, white shirt, body proportions and identity. Preserve the exact camera, crate size and position, green leaf symbol, storage room, doorway, lamp, walls, floor and warm lighting. The concealed DJ equipment must remain completely invisible. No full reveal, no climbing out, no dancing, no waving, no confetti, no explosion, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts, no new people, no extra limbs, no face morphing, no text changes and no watermark.
